newsitem.title: USA: Circus Circus seen issuing debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Circus Circus seen issuing debt deal.

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprises Inc is expected to issue a $300 million two-part debt offering, syndicate sources said on Wednesday.
The first tranche is expected to consist of $150 million in 100-year bonds, which are puttable in the seventh year, via Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, sources said.
The second tranche is for $150 million in 40-year bonds with a put option in the 12th year via underwriter Goldman, Sachs & Co Inc.
Earlier in the week, Circus Circus announced it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in debt securities.

The Las Vegas-based company said it intends to use the proceeds from the sale for general corporate purposes, which may include acquisitions, capital expenditures and repurchases of shares of the company's common stock.
